context.title: نافذة
context.poem:
لَمْ أبع الوعد ولم أنسَ وجهك
وأتركُ نافذتي للضوء

cases.request: Open Diwan with my current poem «نافذة» from current.txt. I want to edit it here. Keep it private.
criteria: Creates a preloaded local editor with the exact supplied text and review status
Uses the available local opener in this turn
Does not ask another permission question or require pasting the poem
Does not publish or request hosted services
Does not rebuild or write to the installed package

cases.request: افتح ديوان بقصيدتي الحالية «نافذة» من ملف current.txt، حتى أراجعها الآن. أبقها خاصة.
criteria: Answers in Arabic and preserves the supplied text and marks

cases.request: Open Diwan with my current poem «نافذة» from current.txt. I want to edit it here. Keep it private.
criteria: Prepares a local editor with the poem loaded
Explains that no local viewer is available instead of claiming it opened
Provides the prepared file as the remaining handoff without asking the user to paste

cases.request: اشرح الصورة في السطر الثاني من current.txt باختصار. أريد الرد هنا دون فتح المحرر أو تغيير النص.
criteria: Explains the supplied image in Arabic
Does not prepare or open Diwan

software_scenarios: Exact text, tashkeel and line breaks render on first open
Reopening selects the requested poem and preserves newer saved edits
Different poems have different identities and do not erase each other
Blocked browser storage still renders the initial poem with a persistence warning
Poem text containing HTML/script delimiters is embedded as data
The local bridge serves a prepared page and retains request/response support
Builder help and invalid flags do not write a build output
